title: Action
description: A proposed next research action produced by the host agent and validated before it is queued.

type.description: deepen goes deeper into a known thread, broaden opens a new related one, verify checks an existing claim, backtrack revisits an earlier assumption.

reason.description: Why this action is worth its budget now.

time_window_days.description: Recency window in days. Null means no window; only verify may use null, and that rule is enforced by the action admission gate, not here.

scope_justification.description: How this action stays inside the declared core/related scope, or why it belongs in a separate candidate topic.
